method: Two saved Chrome probes before the explicit 48 kHz request. The stress result directly records a 96 kHz context. The separate functional result records the retained PCM byte counts.
limitations: The captures cover the recorded interactions and timing sequences in Chrome.
Audio was routed to a zero-gain bus or muted native media. These are signal and control checks, not an audition.
Physical iPhone and Safari behavior, browser heap, and subjective musical expression were not measured.
The functional capture did not itself record a sample-rate field; the 96 kHz observation comes from the stress capture.
The historical probe scripts can differ from the current supplied checks. Byte counts are held PCM references, not total browser memory.

functional.method: Actual Chrome audio decoding and controls, routed through a separate zero-gain output bus.

stress.method: Actual source start/stop intervals and UI behavior, routed through a muted output bus.
